# Facundo Majda

> AI/ML & Automation Engineer. I design and ship production AI systems — RAG pipelines, LLM agents, computer vision, NLP — plus the backend, APIs and frontends that hold them up. 3+ years engineering, available for remote roles and selected projects.

Facundo Majda is an AI/ML & Automation Engineer focused on taking AI from prototype to production: retrieval-augmented generation, LLM agents and orchestration, computer vision, NLP, and the automation that connects those systems to real operations. He works end to end — backend services and APIs through to the interfaces that make them usable.
